title: Lotus Trap's 'Double all damage that would be dealt to it this turn' has no effect
expected: Repo-wide grep for "DoubleIncomingDamage" across packages/ and apps/ finds exactly one hit: the card definition packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/lotus-trap.ts:16 (grant-keyword effect). The engine damage pipeline in packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/damage.ts:260-325 iterates hits and applies `amount` verbatim (addCounter at :316, meta.damage = priorDamage + amount at :320) with only take-damage replacement checks (prevent/alt-effect) — no keyword lookup or multiplier anywhere. So the granted keyword is inert and Falling Star deals 3, not 6.
observed: Wurm received grantedKeywords=[{keyword:'DoubleIncomingDamage',duration:'turn'}] but Falling Star dealt exactly 3 damage (meta.damage=3). Reproduced twice (cast normally before the damage spell, and cast as a Reaction on top of Falling Star in the chain). grep shows 'DoubleIncomingDamage' is only referenced in packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/lotus-trap.ts — the engine's damage pipeline never consumes the keyword.
